en: A monochrome (sepia-toned) photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo ship at sea, taken from the side while it moves through slightly rough waters. The vessel has two tall masts, a bridge and accommodation block toward the stern, and several crew visible on deck near the bow. The name of the ship, "KÄTHE-MARIE," is painted on the bow. The background is an open sea with no coastline visible, and the sky is light and mostly empty.
